content: 1. Always consult your healthcare professional for comprehensive information about this medication and to address your specific health needs. 2. Before starting entecavir, inform your doctor or pharmacist if you have any allergies to this medication or any other substances. This product may contain inactive ingredients that could trigger allergic reactions or other complications. 3. This medication may cause dizziness. Consuming alcohol or marijuana (cannabis) can exacerbate this effect. Avoid driving, operating machinery, or engaging in activities requiring alertness until you are certain you can perform them safely. Refrain from consuming alcoholic beverages, as alcohol may also worsen liver conditions. 4. To reduce the risk of transmitting hepatitis B to others, always use an effective barrier method, such as latex or polyurethane condoms or dental dams, during all sexual activities. 5. During pregnancy, this medication should only be used if clearly necessary. It is not known whether this medication prevents the transmission of the hepatitis B virus from mother to baby. Additionally, it is unclear if this medication passes into breast milk. If you have HIV, breastfeeding may transmit the virus to your infant. 6. Drug interactions can alter the effectiveness of your medications or increase the risk of serious side effects. This document does not list all possible drug interactions. Maintain a list of all products you use, including prescription and non-prescription drugs and herbal supplements, and share it with your doctor and pharmacist. 7. In the event of an overdose with serious symptoms such as loss of consciousness or difficulty breathing, call 911 immediately. Otherwise, contact a poison control center right away. U.S. residents can call 1-800-222-1222. 8. While taking this medication, laboratory and/or medical tests, such as liver function tests and viral load measurements, should be conducted regularly to monitor your condition and response to treatment. 9. If you miss a dose, take it as soon as you remember. If it is close to the time of your next dose, skip the missed dose and resume your regular dosing schedule. Do not double the dose to catch up. 10. Store this medication at room temperature, away from light and moisture. Keep the medication in its original packaging to protect it from light. Do not store it in the bathroom. Do not flush medications down the toilet or pour them into a drain unless instructed to do so. Properly discard this product when it is expired or no longer needed. 11. This information was last revised in August 2024. It is a summary and does not include all possible details about this product. It does not guarantee that the product is safe, effective, or appropriate for you. This information is not a substitute for individualized medical advice. Always consult your healthcare professional for complete information about this product and your specific health needs. 12.
